action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL BUG: Fix signup error handling in /app/frontend/src/pages/Auth.js. When backend returns 422 validation error, frontend tries to render Pydantic error object directly causing React error: 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, ctx})'. Error handling at line 77 needs to format validation errors properly before displaying in toast. Suggested fix: Check if err.response?.data?.detail is an array, then extract and format error messages (e.g., detail.map(e => e.msg).join(', ')).
